purpose: New low-power GenAI accelerator variants and high-bandwidth edge-AI memory hardware. Memory-only products are not standalone compute accelerators and must be paired with a compatible host.

supported_os: Android (B2B support currently broader than consumer support)

quantization.verified_hailo_llm_path: A8W4 is used by current Hailo-10H model-zoo LLMs; Hailo also documents 4-bit group-wise weights with 8-bit activations/KV cache.
quantization.notes: Models generally require Hailo compilation/HEF artifacts; do not assume arbitrary GGUF/GPTQ/AWQ binaries can execute unchanged.

llm_suitability.practical_guidance: Best suited to roughly 1B-3B compiled LLM/VLM workloads and speech/vision pipelines. The 8GB dedicated memory is useful, but current public Hailo model evidence is concentrated on small models rather than unrestricted 7B+ deployment.

hardware.off_grid_notes: 2.5W typical accelerator consumption is extremely low; complete-system consumption depends on the host and USB power path.

pricing.note: Current Taiwan retail listing for UGen300 USB 8G.

hardware.notes: The Hailo reference LLM benchmarks are not claimed as measured UGen300 USB results; USB transport and host integration can affect end-to-end behavior.

quantization.verified_hailo_llm_path: A8W4 / 4-bit group-wise weight quantization with 8-bit activations is documented for Hailo-10H LLM deployment.

llm_suitability.practical_guidance: Same Hailo-10H compute/memory class as the USB variant, with PCIe attachment better suited to embedded systems. Current public model evidence is strongest for 1B-3B compiled models.

pricing.note: Current Taiwan retail listing for UGen300 M.2 8G.

hardware.notes: Do not confuse the 8GB version with lower-memory Hailo-10H M.2 variants; 2GB modules can be materially more constrained for GenAI.

hardware.interface_notes: High-density/high-pin-count removable connector intended for compatible AI-agent host motherboards; not a JEDEC DDR5 DIMM and not universally socket-compatible.

llm_suitability.vendor_claim: Longsys says one module can stably support 70B+ edge LLMs.
llm_suitability.caveat: Memory capacity/bandwidth does not by itself determine token throughput; a compatible SoC/APU/GPU and software stack are required.

hardware.off_grid_notes: Dynamic voltage scaling and FDVFS target lower power, but Longsys has not published a defensible module wattage.

pricing.note: No stable public unit price found.

hardware.notes: Treat as a memory technology, not an accelerator. Compatibility with any specific Ryzen AI/Intel/Arm host must be verified at the motherboard/platform level.

hardware.interface_notes: Designed for native LPDDR-compatible integration in embedded AI systems; soldered/package-level component rather than user-replaceable DIMM.

llm_suitability.practical_guidance: 24-64GB capacity can materially improve model fit for embedded systems, but exact model size and speed depend on the attached compute SoC and software.
llm_suitability.vendor_positioning: Longsys positions AILPBGA for compact edge inference and medium/lightweight model deployment.

hardware.off_grid_notes: Longsys describes a low-power design but has not published defensible wattage.

pricing.note: No stable public unit price found.

hardware.notes: Do not compare the 307 GB/s memory figure to accelerator TOPS or tokens/sec; this part provides memory bandwidth/capacity, not compute.
